svg.title: The finite packet at horizon D is P m≤D ιm,Dhm. Applying πj,D gives exactly hj for j ≤D, indepen- dent of D. For a single field at its center the packet is precisely its inclusion, by (OE3). Pairing the packet with a spectator correlation gives the finite sum in (OE1), by linearity and the component inclusion identities. These are exact compatibility identities, not asymptotic approximations.
